meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 arboreto 从基因表达数据推断调控网络,得到“转录因子—靶基因—调控强度”的关系表,可用 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3 算法,并支持本地多核或远程集群计算。
howto.when: 当你分析转录组数据(如 bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq 等),需要找出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 GRNBoost2 从这份表达数据推断调控网络。
用 GENIE3 跑一下,只保留我列表里的转录因子。
say.note: 会按 tf_names 过滤再运行 GENIE3。

say.text: 按条件拆分表达数据,分别推断网络并比较结果。
say.note: 会对每个条件各跑一次,保存各自的网络文件。

howto.what_en: Claude can use arboreto to infer gene regulatory networks from gene expression data, producing a table of TF–target links with importance scores. Supports GRNBoost2 and GENIE3, and can scale from local multi-core to remote Dask clusters.
howto.when_en: Triggered when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, etc.) to identify transcription factor–target gene relationships and regulatory interactions.

say_en.text: Run GRNBoost2 on this expression file and infer the regulatory network.
Run GENIE3 but keep only the transcription factors in my list.
say_en.note: Filters by tf_names while running GENIE3.

say_en.text: Split the expression matrix by condition, infer each network, then compare.
say_en.note: Runs per condition and saves each network file.
